name: Google Sans
summary: Variable sans-serif by Google with grade, optical-size and weight axes, roman and italic, spanning many scripts.
description: Google Sans is a variable sans-serif designed by Google, released as roman and italic variable files with GRAD, optical-size and weight axes. It covers a wide range of scripts, from Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Hebrew to Devanagari, Thai and Vietnamese. Free under the SIL Open Font License.
contains: 27 subsets incl. latin, cyrillic, greek, hebrew, devanagari, thai, vietnamese
